# Tolia by Innobiz

> Tolia is a waterless, battery-powered essential oil diffuser designed in France by Innobiz for aromatherapy brands. It works straight from the brand's own standard bottles (DIN 18 neck, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 50 ml): no water, no cleaning, a different oil in one second. Brands sell it under their own name (white label, typically from 3,000 units) or from stock under the Tolia brand (from 500 units).

## Key facts

- Designed in France by Innobiz (INNOBIZ SARL, Jacou, near Montpellier), founded by Pierre-Emmanuel Thuret ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pierre-emmanuel-thuret-b5bb7910/)).
- Battery-powered: up to 90 hours of battery life (70 to 90 h with the light off, 16 to 20 h with the ambient light on, depending on intensity); USB-C charging; user-replaceable battery.
- Waterless and heat-free: the essential oil is diffused pure, nothing to fill or clean.
- Changing oil takes 1 second: a diffusion module stays screwed onto each bottle, which then clips into the base.
- Diffusion time, strength and on/off cycles are easy to adjust; modes can be pre-programmed to the brand's recommendations.
- Exclusive diffusion technology developed by Innobiz: diffuses every essential oil on the market (more than 150 essential oils and blends tested), as well as natural fragrances and synthetic home fragrances, a performance no other pure-oil diffuser achieves today.
- The bottle screws onto its diffusion module without removing the dropper.
- Fully customisable for brands: colour (RAL or Pantone), finishes, materials, logo, box, diffusion modes.
- White label: typically from 3,000 units, 12 to 20 weeks. Stock order: from 500 units, ships from France within 72 h if in stock.
- CE-marked and RoHS-compliant. More than 100,000 diffusers using our technology have been sold worldwide.
- Free sample for brands; reply within one business day. Or book a 30-minute video call with Simon Desbuisson (Innobiz): https://calendly.com/simon-innobiz/30min
